meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

copy.tagline: 触发智能体的特殊工作模式,加载预先设定的规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Codex 且希望它遵守你的自定义工作规则
copy.tagline_en: Trigger a special agent mode and load its predefined rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want it to follow your custom working rules.

howto.what: 当你说“ultrawork”或“ulw”，AI进入严谨模式：先显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，再先写失败测试后实现，最后真实环境验证并清理。
howto.when: 当提示中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.note: AI会进入严谨模式并按流程工作。

say.text: ulw，帮我写一个函数并测试。
say.note: 会先写失败测试再实现。
会捕获证据证明修复有效。

howto.what_en: When you say 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', the AI enters a rigorous mode: it first prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then writes failing tests before implementing, and finally verifies and cleans up on the real surface.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Complete this task in ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: The AI enters rigorous mode and follows the workflow.

say_en.text: ulw, write a function and verify it.
say_en.note: It writes failing tests first, then implements.
It captures evidence to prove the fix.
